open BigOperators
open Finset

structure Shape where
  n : Nat
  dims : Fin n → Nat
  hpos : ∀ i, 0 < dims i

namespace Shape

def dimsList (s : Shape) : List Nat := List.ofFn (fun i : Fin s.n => s.dims i)

def size (s : Shape) : Nat := ∏ i : Fin s.n, s.dims i

lemma size_pos (s : Shape) : 0 < s.size := by
  unfold size
  classical
  refine Finset.induction_on (s := (Finset.univ : Finset (Fin s.n))) ?h0 ?hstep
  · simp
  · intro a S ha hS
    have ha0 : 0 < s.dims a := s.hpos a
    have hprod : 0 < ∏ j : Fin s.n in S, s.dims j := hS
    simpa [ha, Finset.mul_prod, Nat.mul_pos, ha0, hprod] done

end Shape

def MultiIndex (s : Shape) := ∀ i : Fin s.n, Fin (s.dims i)

namespace MultiIndex

def toList {s : Shape} (x : MultiIndex s) : List Nat := List.ofFn (fun i : Fin s.n => (x i).val)

lemma length_toList {s : Shape} (x : MultiIndex s) : (toList x).length = s.n := by
  unfold toList
  simpa using List.length_ofFn (fun i : Fin s.n => (x i).val) done

lemma bounds_nthLe {s : Shape} (x : MultiIndex s) (k : Nat) (hk : k < s.n) :
  (List.nthLe (toList x) k (by simpa [length_toList] using hk)) < (List.nthLe (Shape.dimsList s) k (by
    dsimp [Shape.dimsList]
    simpa using hk)) := by
  classical
  have : List.nthLe (toList x) k (by simpa [length_toList] using hk) = (x ⟨k, hk⟩).val := by
    simp [toList, List.nthLe_ofFn]
  have : (x ⟨k, hk⟩).val < s.dims ⟨k, hk⟩ := (x ⟨k, hk⟩).is_lt
  have : (List.nthLe (toList x) k (by simpa [length_toList] using hk)) < s.dims ⟨k, hk⟩ := by simpa [toList, List.nthLe_ofFn] using this
  have hdim : List.nthLe (Shape.dimsList s) k (by
    dsimp [Shape.dimsList]
    simpa using hk) = s.dims ⟨k, hk⟩ := by
    simp [Shape.dimsList, List.nthLe_ofFn]
  simpa [hdim] using this done

end MultiIndex

def lprod (l : List Nat) : Nat := l.foldr Nat.mul 1

lemma lprod_nil : lprod [] = 1 := by rfl

lemma lprod_cons (a : Nat) (l : List Nat) : lprod (a :: l) = a * lprod l := by rfl

def flattenWithDims : List Nat → List Nat → Nat
| [], [] => 0
| (d :: ds), (i :: is) => i * lprod ds + flattenWithDims ds is
| _, _ => 0

def sizeWithDims : List Nat → Nat := lprod

lemma sizeWithDims_cons (d : Nat) (ds : List Nat) : sizeWithDims (d :: ds) = d * sizeWithDims ds := by rfl

def flatten {s : Shape} (x : MultiIndex s) : Nat :=
  flattenWithDims (Shape.dimsList s) (MultiIndex.toList x)

def sizeNat {s : Shape} : Nat := Shape.size s

lemma sizeNat_eq {s : Shape} : sizeNat = s.size := rfl

lemma dimsList_len {s : Shape} : (Shape.dimsList s).length = s.n := by
  unfold Shape.dimsList
  simpa using List.length_ofFn (fun i : Fin s.n => s.dims i) done

lemma dimsList_pos_head_tail {s : Shape} :
  ∀ (k : Nat) (hk : k < s.n), 0 < List.nthLe (Shape.dimsList s) k (by
    dsimp [Shape.dimsList]; simpa using hk) := by
  intro k hk
  classical
  have := s.hpos ⟨k, hk⟩
  simpa [Shape.dimsList, List.nthLe_ofFn] using this done

lemma lprod_pos_of_pos_all :
  ∀ (l : List Nat), (∀ a ∈ l, 0 < a) → 0 < lprod l
| [], _ => by simp [lprod]
| a :: l, h => by
  have ha : 0 < a := by exact h a (by simp)
  have hl : 0 < lprod l := lprod_pos_of_pos_all l (by
    intro b hb
    exact h b (by simp [hb]))
  simp [lprod, Nat.mul_pos, ha, hl] done

lemma flatten_lt_sizeWithDims :
  ∀ (ds is : List Nat), ds.length = is.length → (∀ k, k < ds.length → (List.nthLe is k (by simpa using ‹_›)) < (List.nthLe ds k (by simpa using ‹_›)))
    → flattenWithDims ds is < sizeWithDims ds
| [], [], _, _ => by simp [flattenWithDims, sizeWithDims, lprod]
| d :: ds, i :: is, hlen, hb => by
  have hlen' : ds.length = is.length := by simpa using congrArg Nat.pred hlen
  have hb' : ∀ k, k < ds.length → List.nthLe is k (by simpa using ‹_›) < List.nthLe ds k (by simpa using ‹_›) := by
    intro k hk
    specialize hb (k.succ)
    have : k.succ < (d :: ds).length := by simpa using Nat.succ_lt_succ hk
    simpa [List.nthLe] using hb (k.succ) this
  have hind := flatten_lt_sizeWithDims ds is hlen' hb'
  have hpos : 0 < lprod ds := by
    apply lprod_pos_of_pos_all ds
    intro a ha
    obtain ⟨k, hk, hkth⟩ := List.exists_of_mem_ofFn ha
    have : List.nthLe (Shape.dimsList ⟨0, fun j => True.intro⟩) ?_ ?_ = a := by cases hkth; simp
    exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt Nat.zero_le (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt Nat.zero_le (Nat.succ_lt_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_gt (Nat.succ_pos _)))) Nat.le_of_lt_succ))
  have hi_lt_d : i < d := by
    specialize hb 0
    have : 0 < (d :: ds).length := by simp
    have := hb 0 this
    simpa using this
  have term_lt : i * lprod ds < d * lprod ds := Nat.mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hi_lt_d (by
    have : 0 < lprod ds := by
      have : ∀ a ∈ ds, 0 < a := by
        intro a ha
        exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_gt (Nat.succ_pos _))
      exact lprod_pos_of_pos_all ds (by
        intro a ha
        exact Nat.succ_le_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_gt (Nat.succ_pos _)))
    simpa using this)
  have : i * lprod ds + flattenWithDims ds is < d * lprod ds + lprod ds := by
    exact Nat.add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le term_lt (le_of_lt hind)
  simpa [flattenWithDims, sizeWithDims, lprod] using this
| _, _, hlen, hb => by
  have := Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.pos_of_ne_zero (by intro h; cases ds <;> cases is <;> cases h))
  simp [flattenWithDims, sizeWithDims, lprod] done

lemma dims_list_all_pos {s : Shape} : ∀ a ∈ Shape.dimsList s, 0 < a := by
  intro a ha
  classical
  rcases List.mem_ofFn.1 ha with ⟨i, rfl⟩
  simpa [Shape.dimsList] using s.hpos i done

lemma size_eq_sizeWithDims {s : Shape} :
  s.size = sizeWithDims (Shape.dimsList s) := by
  classical
  unfold Shape.size Shape.dimsList sizeWithDims lprod
  have : (∏ i : Fin s.n, s.dims i) = (List.ofFn (fun i : Fin s.n => s.dims i)).foldr Nat.mul 1 := by
    simpa [Finset.univ_eq_attach, Finset.attach_univ, List.ofFn_foldr, List.foldr_map] using rfl
  simpa using this done

lemma flatten_lt_size {s : Shape} (x : MultiIndex s) : flatten x < s.size := by
  classical
  unfold flatten
  have hlen : (Shape.dimsList s).length = (MultiIndex.toList x).length := by
    simpa [Shape.dimsList, MultiIndex.toList, List.length_ofFn] using rfl
  have hb : ∀ k, k < (Shape.dimsList s).length →
    List.nthLe (MultiIndex.toList x) k (by
      simpa [MultiIndex.length_toList] using ‹k < (Shape.dimsList s).length›) <
    List.nthLe (Shape.dimsList s) k (by
      simpa using ‹k < (Shape.dimsList s).length›) := by
    intro k hk
    have hk' : k < s.n := by
      simpa [dimsList_len] using hk
    simpa [MultiIndex.toList, Shape.dimsList, List.nthLe_ofFn] using MultiIndex.bounds_nthLe x k hk'
  have h := flatten_lt_sizeWithDims (Shape.dimsList s) (MultiIndex.toList x) hlen hb
  simpa [size_eq_sizeWithDims] using h done

structure SharedData where
  size : Nat
  f : Fin size → ℝ
  ref : Nat
  id : Nat

namespace SharedData

def mkConst (size : Nat) (c : ℝ) : SharedData :=
  { size := size, f := fun _ => c, ref := 1, id := 0 }

def incRef (d : SharedData) : SharedData := { d with ref := d.ref + 1 }

def decRef (d : SharedData) : SharedData := { d with ref := d.ref - 1 }

theorem decRef_nonneg (d : SharedData) (h : 0 < d.ref) : 0 ≤ (decRef d).ref := by
  dsimp [decRef]
  exact Nat.sub_le _ _ done

theorem incRef_pos (d : SharedData) : 0 < (incRef d).ref := by
  dsimp [incRef]
  exact Nat.succ_pos _ done

lemma size_eq (d : SharedData) : d.size = d.size := rfl

end SharedData

structure Tensor where
  shape : Shape
  store : SharedData
  hsize : store.size = shape.size

namespace Tensor

def valueAt (t : Tensor) (x : MultiIndex t.shape) : ℝ :=
  let idx := flatten x
  let hlt := flatten_lt_size x
  let fin : Fin t.store.size := Fin.mk idx (by simpa [t.hsize] using hlt)
  t.store.f fin

def fill (s : Shape) (c : ℝ) : Tensor :=
  { shape := s
    store := SharedData.mkConst s.size c
    hsize := by rfl }

def zeros (s : Shape) : Tensor := fill s 0

def ones (s : Shape) : Tensor := fill s 1

def ensureWritable (t : Tensor) : Tensor :=
  if h : t.store.ref = 1 then t
  else
    { shape := t.shape
      store := { size := t.store.size, f := t.store.f, ref := 1, id := t.store.id + 1 }
      hsize := t.hsize }

lemma ensureWritable_idempotent (t : Tensor) : (ensureWritable t).shape = t.shape := by
  unfold ensureWritable
  split
  · simp
  · simp done

lemma ensureWritable_unique (t : Tensor) :
  (ensureWritable t).store.ref = 1 := by
  unfold ensureWritable
  split
  · simp [*]
  · simp done

lemma ensureWritable_preserve (t : Tensor) (x : MultiIndex t.shape) :
  (ensureWritable t).valueAt x = t.valueAt x := by
  unfold valueAt ensureWritable
  split
  · simp
  · simp done

def map (t : Tensor) (g : ℝ → ℝ) : Tensor :=
  { shape := t.shape
    store :=
      { size := t.store.size
        f := fun i => g (t.store.f i)
        ref := 1
        id := t.store.id + 1 }
    hsize := t.hsize }

def map2 (a b : Tensor) (hshape : a.shape = b.shape) (g : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) : Tensor :=
  let s := a.shape
  have hb : b.shape = s := by simpa using hshape.symm
  { shape := s
    store :=
      { size := a.store.size
        f := fun i => g (a.store.f i) (b.store.f (by
          have : b.store.size = a.store.size := by
            have : a.shape.size = b.shape.size := by simpa [hshape] using rfl
            simpa [a.hsize, b.hsize, this]
          exact cast (by simpa [this]) i))
        ref := 1
        id := a.store.id + b.store.id + 1 }
    hsize := by simpa [a.hsize] }

def add (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape = b.shape) : Tensor := map2 a b h (· + ·)
def sub (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape = b.shape) : Tensor := map2 a b h (· - ·)
def mul (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape = b.shape) : Tensor := map2 a b h (· * ·)
def div (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape = b.shape) : Tensor := map2 a b h (· / ·)

def scalarAdd (a : Tensor) (c : ℝ) : Tensor := map a (fun x => x + c)
def scalarSub (a : Tensor) (c : ℝ) : Tensor := map a (fun x => x - c)
def scalarMul (a : Tensor) (c : ℝ) : Tensor := map a (fun x => x * c)
def scalarDiv (a : Tensor) (c : ℝ) : Tensor := map a (fun x => x / c)

def exp (a : Tensor) : Tensor := map a Real.exp
def log (a : Tensor) : Tensor := map a Real.log
def sin (a : Tensor) : Tensor := map a Real.sin
def cos (a : Tensor) : Tensor := map a Real.cos
def tan (a : Tensor) : Tensor := map a Real.tan
def sqrt (a : Tensor) : Tensor := map a Real.sqrt
def abs (a : Tensor) : Tensor := map a Real.abs
def pow (a : Tensor) (c : ℝ) : Tensor := map a (fun x => Real.rpow x c)
def relu (a : Tensor) : Tensor := map a (fun x => if x < 0 then 0 else x)

theorem add_correct (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape = b.shape) (x : MultiIndex a.shape) :
  (add a b h).valueAt x = a.valueAt x + b.valueAt (by simpa [h] using x) := by
  unfold add map2 valueAt
  simp done

theorem mul_correct (a b : Tensor) (h : a.shape = b.shape) (x : MultiIndex a.shape) :
  (mul a b h).valueAt x = a.valueAt x * b.valueAt (by simpa [h] using x) := by
  unfold mul map2 valueAt
  simp done

def reshape (t : Tensor) (s' : Shape) (hsize : s'.size = t.shape.size) : Tensor :=
  { shape := s'
    store := t.store
    hsize := by
      have : t.store.size = t.shape.size := t.hsize
      simpa [this, hsize] }

theorem reshape_preserve_linear (t : Tensor) (s' : Shape) (hsize : s'.size = t.shape.size)
  (y : MultiIndex s') :
  (reshape t s' hsize).valueAt y = t.store.f ⟨flatten y, by
    have := flatten_lt_size y
    simpa [t.hsize, hsize, sizeNat_eq] using this⟩ := by
  unfold reshape valueAt
  simp done

def unsqueeze (t : Tensor) (k : Fin (t.shape.n + 1)) : Tensor :=
  let s' : Shape :=
    { n := t.shape.n + 1
      dims := fun i =>
        if h : i = k then 1 else
          if h2 : i.val < k.val then t.shape.dims ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_trans (by
            have := i.isLt; exact this) (by exact Nat.lt_succ_self _)⟩
          else t.shape.dims ⟨i.val - 1, by
            have : i.val ≠ k.val := by
              have : (i = k) = False := by
                have : Decidable (i = k) := Classical.decEq (Fin (t.shape.n + 1))
                exact propext (by classical; by_cases h3 : i = k <;> simp [h3])
              simpa using this
            have hi : i.val.succ ≤ t.shape.n.succ := le_of_lt i.isLt
            have hk : k.val < t.shape.n.succ := k.isLt
            exact Nat.pred_lt_pred (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hi (by simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using this))⟩
      hpos := by
        intro i
        by_cases hi : i = k
        · simp [hi]
        · have : 0 < 1 := by decide
          by_cases h2 : i.val < k.val
          · have hpos := t.shape.hpos ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_trans (by
              have := i.isLt; exact this) (by exact Nat.lt_succ_self _)⟩
            simpa [hi, h2] using hpos
          · have hpos := t.shape.hpos ⟨i.val - 1, by
              have hi' : i.val.succ ≤ t.shape.n.succ := le_of_lt i.isLt
              have hk' : k.val < t.shape.n.succ := k.isLt
              have : i.val ≠ k.val := by
                have : (i = k) = False := by
                  have : Decidable (i = k) := Classical.decEq (Fin (t.shape.n + 1))
                  exact propext (by classical; by_cases h3 : i = k <;> simp [h3])
                simpa using this
              exact Nat.pred_lt_pred (Nat.lt_of_le_of_ne hi' (by simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one] using this))⟩
            simpa [hi, h2] using hpos }
  reshape t s' (by
    have : s'.size = t.shape.size := by
      classical
      have : (∏ i : Fin (t.shape.n + 1), s'.dims i) = ∏ j : Fin t.shape.n, t.shape.dims j := by
        classical
        have : (Fin (t.shape.n + 1)) ≃ Option (Fin t.shape.n) := Fin.succEquiv
        simpa [s', Finset.univ_eq_attach, Finset.attach_univ] using rfl
      simpa [Shape.size] using this
    simpa using this)

def reduceAxis (t : Tensor) (axis : Fin t.shape.n) (op : ℝ → ℝ → ℝ) (ne : ℝ) : Tensor :=
  let s : Shape :=
    { n := t.shape.n - 1
      dims := fun i =>
        if h : i.val < axis.val then t.shape.dims ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_trans (by have := i.isLt; exact this) (by exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.pred_le _) axis.isLt)⟩
        else t.shape.dims ⟨i.val + 1, by
          have : i.val + 1 < t.shape.n := by
            have : i.val < t.shape.n - 1 := i.isLt
            exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (by exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ this) (by simpa using axis.isLt)
          exact this⟩
      hpos := by
        intro i
        by_cases h : i.val < axis.val
        · have := t.shape.hpos ⟨i.val, Nat.lt_trans (by have := i.isLt; exact this) (by exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.pred_le _) axis.isLt)⟩
          simpa [h] using this
        · have := t.shape.hpos ⟨i.val + 1, by
            have : i.val + 1 < t.shape.n := by
              have : i.val < t.shape.n - 1 := i.isLt
              exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (by exact Nat.le_of_lt_succ this) (by simpa using axis.isLt)
            exact this⟩
          simpa [h] using this }
  let f : MultiIndex s → ℝ := fun y =>
    let kmax := t.shape.dims axis
    let S := Finset.range kmax
    S.fold (fun acc j => op acc (t.valueAt (fun l =>
      if h : l = axis then ⟨j, by
        have : j < t.shape.dims axis := by
          have : j ∈ S := by simpa
          simpa [S] using Finset.mem_range.1 this
        simpa [h] using this
      else
        if h2 : l.val < axis.val then
          have : l = ⟨l.val, l.isLt⟩ := by cases l; simp
          have : (y ⟨l.val, Nat.lt_trans (by have := l.isLt; exact this) (by exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.pred_le _) axis.isLt)⟩).val < t.shape.dims l := (y _).is_lt
          ⟨(y ⟨l.val, Nat.lt_trans (by have := l.isLt; exact this) (by exact Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.pred_le _) axis.isLt)⟩).val, this⟩
        else
          have : l = ⟨l.val, l.isLt⟩ := by cases l; simp
          have : (y ⟨l.val - 1, by
            have : l.val + 1 < t.shape.n := by
              have : l.val < t.shape.n := l.isLt
              exact Nat.succ_lt_of_lt this
            exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.pred_lt (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.succ_pos _))) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ this)⟩).val < t.shape.dims l := by
            have := (y _).is_lt
            exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le this (Nat.le_of_eq (by rfl))
          ⟨(y ⟨l.val - 1, by
            have : l.val + 1 < t.shape.n := by
              have : l.val < t.shape.n := l.isLt
              exact Nat.succ_lt_of_lt this
            exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.pred_lt (Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.succ_pos _))) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ this)⟩).val, this⟩))) ne
  { shape := s
    store :=
      { size := s.size
        f := fun i =>
          let y : MultiIndex s := fun j => i.castLT (by simpa [s.size] using j.isLt)
          f y
        ref := 1
        id := t.store.id + 1 }
    hsize := rfl }

def sumAxis (t : Tensor) (axis : Fin t.shape.n) : Tensor := reduceAxis t axis (· + ·) 0
def maxAxis (t : Tensor) (axis : Fin t.shape.n) : Tensor := reduceAxis t axis (fun a b => if a < b then b else a) (-(1:ℝ/((0:ℝ)))) -- dummy not used
def minAxis (t : Tensor) (axis : Fin t.shape.n) : Tensor := reduceAxis t axis (fun a b => if a < b then a else b) (1:ℝ)

def meanAxis (t : Tensor) (axis : Fin t.shape.n) : Tensor :=
  let s := sumAxis t axis
  let denom : ℝ := t.shape.dims axis
  scalarDiv s denom

def softmax1D (t : Tensor) (h1 : t.shape.n = 1) : Tensor :=
  let s := t.shape
  let n := s.dims ⟨0, by simpa [h1] using Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
  let S := Finset.range n
  let maxv := S.sup' (by
    have : 0 < n := by exact s.hpos ⟨0, by simpa [h1] using Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
    exact ⟨0, by simpa [S] using Finset.mem_range.2 this⟩) (fun j => t.valueAt (fun _ => ⟨j, by
      have : j < n := (by
        have : j ∈ S := by
          have := Finset.mem_range.1
          exact by
            have : j ∈ S := by
              have := (by
                have : j ∈ S := by
                  exact by decide)
              exact this
            exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (by exact Nat.zero_lt_one) (by exact le_of_lt (by exact Nat.succ_lt_succ (by exact Nat.zero_lt_one))) )
      simpa [h1] using this⟩))
  let den := ∑ j in S, Real.exp (t.valueAt (fun _ => ⟨j, by
      have : j < n := by
        have : j ∈ S := by
          exact by decide
        exact Finset.mem_range.1 this
      simpa [h1] using this⟩) - maxv)
  map t (fun x => Real.exp (x - maxv) / den)

theorem softmax1D_nonneg (t : Tensor) (h1 : t.shape.n = 1) (x : MultiIndex t.shape) :
  0 ≤ (softmax1D t h1).valueAt x := by
  unfold softmax1D valueAt
  simp
  have hx : 0 ≤ Real.exp (t.valueAt x - _) := by exact Real.exp_pos _ |> le_of_lt
  have hden : 0 < ∑ j in Finset.range _, Real.exp _ := by
    refine Finset.sum_pos ?hpos ?hex
    · intro a ha
      exact Real.exp_pos _ ▸ by exact True.intro
    · have : (0:ℝ) < 1 := by exact by decide
      exact this
  exact div_nonneg (le_of_lt (Real.exp_pos _)) (le_of_lt hden) done

theorem softmax1D_sum_one (t : Tensor) (h1 : t.shape.n = 1) :
  ∑ j in Finset.range (t.shape.dims ⟨0, by simpa [h1] using Nat.zero_lt_one⟩),
    (softmax1D t h1).valueAt (fun _ => ⟨j, by
      have : j < t.shape.dims ⟨0, by simpa [h1] using Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ := by
        exact Finset.mem_range.1 (by decide)
      simpa [h1] using this⟩) = 1 := by
  classical
  unfold softmax1D valueAt
  set n := t.shape.dims ⟨0, by simpa [h1] using Nat.zero_lt_one⟩ with hn
  set S := Finset.range n with hS
  set maxv := S.sup' (by
    have : 0 < n := by
      have := t.shape.hpos ⟨0, by simpa [h1] using Nat.zero_lt_one⟩
